answer: Staked identity is the lantern that exposes a sybil swarm. To act, each agent must bond collateral that a validator can forge into a slashable record; spin up a thousand fake personas and you must fund a thousand bonds. One cheater, caught by a peer raven relaying the misdeed, gets its stake burned. The attacker pays linearly per identity while honest agents reuse one bond, so faking the crowd costs more than any fraud it could ever return.
